title: Erdős 895: Sorry Completion (11 sorries)

problemStatement.plain: Formal investigation in combinatorics: Erdős 895: Sorry Completion (11 sorries).

knowledge.progressSummary: FINDING: the formalization is internally inconsistent. (1) IsAdditiveTriple omits a≠b, admitting degenerate (a,a,2a); (2) Fin n ↔ {1,…,n-1} off-by-one. Under the file’s loose def, counterexample_17 is FALSE (Z3 UNSAT: every triangle-free graph on Fin 17 has an independent additive triple) while barber_theorem (n≥18) is true-but-not-sharp. No single definition makes both barber(n≥18) and counterexample_17 true. Corrected: counterexample lives on Fin 18 with distinct vertices; explicit 42-edge witness provided and pure-Python verified.

research/problems/erdos-895-incomplete-01/verify-counterexample.py — pure-Python check of the witness vs exact Lean predicates
Correction note block added to proofs/Proofs/Erdos895Problem.lean (build-safe comment)
insights: IsAdditiveTriple lacks a≠b: the degenerate triple (a,a,2a) is independent whenever a—2a is a non-edge (¬Adj a a is vacuously true), changing the answer vs Barber (distinct vertices).
GraphOnInterval n = SimpleGraph (Fin n) has values {0,…,n-1} with vertex 0 inert, so it models {1,…,n-1}; Barber threshold m=18 ↔ Fin 19, not Fin 18 (off-by-one).
Z3 (sound UNSAT) + pure-Python witness checks: STRICT/distinct def => counterexample on Fin N iff N≤18, property holds iff N≥19 (matches Barber). LOOSE def (file) => property holds for all N≥12.
counterexample_17 (Fin 17) is FALSE under the file’s definition (UNSAT); its sorry is unfillable. threshold_sharp and erdos895_sat_verified inherit the defect.
No single definition makes BOTH barber_theorem (n≥18) AND counterexample_17 (Fin 17) hold simultaneously — the file is internally inconsistent.
Explicit corrected counterexample: triangle-free graph on Fin 18 (={1,…,17}), 42 edges, no DISTINCT independent additive triple; under the loose def the triple (1,1,2) breaks it.
nextSteps: On a build-capable session (Docker up): add a≠b to IsAdditiveTriple, reindex barber_theorem to n≥19 (or {1,…,m}, m≥18), and replace counterexample_17 with a Fin-18 `counterexample` proven by `decide` from counterexample-fin18.json.
Leave barber_theorem as the genuinely open formalization target (Barber’s proof is a large SAT/case computation); document as axiom/sorry with provenance.
barber_theorem and erdos895_sat_verified remain OPEN to formalize — not attemptable via Aristotle (no known short proof).

statement: Erdős 895 (Barber 2015): every triangle-free graph on {1,…,n} with n≥18 has an independent additive triple a,b,a+b (distinct vertices); sharp at n=18. File proofs/Proofs/Erdos895Problem.lean formalizes this with 3 sorries.
